say:3:1421128002:1.text: Consider that a lesson. Being a minstrel involves a lot of walking, you know.
say:3:1421128002:1.source_cn: 这也算是教训吧，如果要当吟游诗人，你以后要经常在外行走。

say:4:1421128003:1.text: Just wear more practical clothes next time. You might be fine in the city, but in rougher places, you'll end up tripping all the time.
say:4:1421128003:1.source_cn: 要记得换上更方便行动的衣服，要不然在城里还好，在环境差...

say:5:1421128004:1.text: I certainly know better now! You won't catch me wearing anything with hems or lace again...
say:5:1421128004:1.source_cn: 呜，我知道了！我回去就做几件方便行动的衣服和靴子，再也...

choice_prompt:6:1421128004.text: I certainly know better now! You won't catch me wearing anything with hems or lace again...
choice_prompt:6:1421128004.source_cn: 呜，我知道了！我回去就做几件方便行动的衣服和靴子，再也不要这些麻烦的下摆了……

say:7:1421128005:1.text: It sure is. Nobles had at least an eighty percent chance of passing if they were well-prepared.
say:7:1421128005:1.source_cn: 是的，如果是贵族子弟，在准备充分的情况下，基本上有八成...

say:8:1421128006:1.text: But for someone who barely made it through the first round, these traps were nothing short of hell.
say:8:1421128006:1.source_cn: 但对于在第一关遍体鳞伤，气喘吁吁的通过者来说，这一片陷...

say:9:1421128007:1.text: Luckily, Imperator Ravion insisted on making the traps less deadly. No one would be killed if they messed up.
say:9:1421128007:1.source_cn: 不过幸好，沙利叶大人当时力排众议，要求去掉陷阱里致命的...

say:10:1421128008:1.text: He also assigned a priest to be on standby for healing and treatment. As a result, there were far fewer casualties and injuries.
say:10:1421128008:1.source_cn: 他还安排了祭司治疗，所以这一关相对来说伤亡率有限，残疾...

say:11:1421128009:1.text: So... you mean there were still casualties...

choice_prompt:12:1421128009.text: So... you mean there were still casualties...

say:13:1421128010:1.text: It was inevitable, given the political influences behind the scenes, but I can tell the Imperator already did his best.
say:13:1421128010:1.source_cn: 毕竟背后有一些政治角力……能做到这种程度，已经是沙利叶...

say:14:1421128011:1.text: All in all, it was the first chance for commoners to rise in the social hierarchy. Even if it cost them their lives, they thought it was worth it.
say:14:1421128011:1.source_cn: 作为平民第一次跨越阶级的测试，只是付出性命就能跨过天堑...

say:15:1421128012:1.text: ... This is outrageous! I can't believe Sal'thorin used to be like this!
say:15:1421128012:1.source_cn: …………太过分了，过去的萨洛克兰，居然是这样子！

say:16:1421128013:1.text: Imperator Ravion, as a reformist, was far less aggressive and more open-minded than the other nobles.
say:16:1421128013:1.source_cn: 沙利叶大人主张改革，手段也相对温和，所以已经是最好说话...

say:17:1421128014:1.text: I suppose you've got a rough idea of the trial by now. It's time for a break.
say:17:1421128014:1.source_cn: 你们体会得也差不多了，我们找个地方休息片刻吧。
